Latest CPC Internal Statistics: Party Membership Reaches 101.286 Million, Primary-Level Party Organizations Total 5.431 Million

According to the latest internal statistics released by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, as of the end of 2025, the total number of CPC members stood at 101.286 million, a net increase of 1.015 million from the previous year. The number of primary-level party organizations reached 5.431 million, a net increase of 181,000.
